title: A gig in Slidell with Earl Palmer
summary: During a union squabble he played in Slidell with a guitarist, Earl Palmer and Ray Tyler.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Yeah, Wilbert Hogan. Yeah, well they had a bunch of musicians came out this city man, I can't remember all of them. And from time to time I'd meet one here and meet one and you know run into all kinds. I remember one time the union had some kind of squabble or something going on, Joe Jones and whatever it was going on. I played with Curtis Trevino, he played guitar. That boy played, he left here and went to California and did good for himself playing drums.

Earl Palmer. Earl Palmer, Ray Tyler, and me and somebody else, I can't remember who was the bass player, we went over to Slidell and played. Had a nice time with those guys man. Those guys were well established you know. I was just coming along man, everything seemed to work out.
